BEFORE_TOKEN.admissible: ordinary glyph and UNK; EOS and BOS forbidden

INSIDE_TOKEN.admissible: ordinary glyph, UNK, EOS; BOS forbidden
INSIDE_TOKEN.at_length_64: TOKEN_COMPLETE structural, no EOS sample and no RNG draw

TOKEN_COMPLETE.action: append nonempty token in occurrence order; start next token at BEFORE_TOKEN or finish corpus

token_length: count of emitted Unicode scalar-value glyphs; not bytes, sampled sentinels, states, or transitions

whole_token.M5: validate NFC scalar token length 1..64; valid -> TOKEN_COMPLETE; invalid -> next attempt; no EOS operation
